; StartSoundSequence: Start a sequence from A after saving A/X/Y in shared scratch. The single-entry path and consecutive-entry path share initialization; X selects a channel through the word-indexed table.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].

; InitializeSoundChannel: Preserve the channel ownership bit, mark it active, install current/restart stream pointers and clear modulation, delay and return-stack state. Initialize the channel register image, then silence its hardware output before playback.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; SilenceAllSoundChannels: Save A/X/Y, clear all nine active channel flags and silence four hardware channels. Restore the saved argument registers through the common suffix.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; SuspendSoundChannels: Save A/X/Y, set active bit7 on eight channel records, silence them and clear the ninth record. Reuse the register restoration suffix.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].

; SuspendSoundWithGate: Save A/X/Y, set the sound suspend gate, silence channel eight and clear the high flag on channels seven through zero and refresh hardware only where flag bit six is set. Restore the original registers through the shared suffix. Requires initialized RAM sound store and live stack above $0194; natural caller is unresolved.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; SaveSoundArguments: Save the three argument registers in shared zero-page scratch; callers restore only the registers required by their entry contract.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; UpdateSoundChannels: Disable frame IRQ through $4017, then scan nine channel records backwards. Process records with active bit7 and without bit6; preserve the scan index across the interpreter.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; UpdateSoundModulation: Apply enabled per-channel modulation stages when their low-bit countdown expires. These stages adjust volume/frequency register images before stream timing advances.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].

; MergeSoundEnvelopePhase: After the envelope update, combine its shape low nibble with the channel phase and join command decoding. The nonzero envelope-counter path returns without calls or mapper writes for channel X zero through eight; this local contract does not promise every envelope input returns.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; UpdateSoundModulation: Apply enabled per-channel modulation stages when their low-bit countdown expires. These stages adjust volume/frequency register images before stream timing advances.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; TickSoundDelay: Decrement the event delay, reload its low-nibble interval when expired, and honor the longer note duration before fetching another stream event.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].

; ReadSoundCommand: Read through the channel stream pointer. Values below $E0 enter note decoding; command bytes use a 32-word return-address table and RTS dispatch. Targets are encoded for RTS rather than ordinary JSR.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].

; Sound command directory:32 little-endian target-minus-one words. The interpreter masks the command to five bits, doubles it, pushes the word and uses RTS to dispatch. These values are return addresses, so the actual handler starts one byte after the stored word.
; SetSoundGateFlag: Set the channel bit3 flag and consume the one-byte command. Its exact musical effect is only partly established by later note decoding.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; ClearSoundGateFlag: Clear channel flag bit3 and consume the command without an operand; exact articulation meaning is uncertain.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; SetSoundTickInterval: Take the operand low nibble as the immediate countdown and as the low half of the packed timing parameter.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; SetSoundDurationScale: Replace the low five bits of the packed scale parameter, then derive the channel timing/register representation.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; SetSoundDurationMode: Pack the operand low three bits into the high bits of the scale parameter. The lower scale bits survive.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; SetSoundVolumeParameter: Store the packed volume/modulation operand and copy its low nibble into the upper timing nibble.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; SetSoundTimingHighNibble: Read one operand, shift its low nibble into the upper timing nibble and preserve the existing low timing nibble.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; SetSoundBranchCounter: Copy the operand to the per-channel branch counter, then consume opcode and operand.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; ClearSoundBranchCounter: Clear the per-channel branch counter and consume only the opcode.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; IncrementSoundBranchCounter: Add one modulo16 to the channel branch counter; the adjacent decrement entry supplies minus one to the same update.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; DecrementSoundBranchCounter: Subtract one modulo16 through the shared branch-counter update.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].

; EnableSoundTransposition: Retain a nonzero operand or reuse the stored parameter, then set its high bit. The pitch decoder applies this enabled transposition; the original musical naming is uncertain.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; DisableSoundTransposition: Clear the transposition enable high bit and consume one command byte.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; EnableSoundVolumeSweep: Enable bit0 modulation and seed its countdown from the operand low nibble. The full operand retains the sweep shape/index.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; DisableSoundVolumeSweep: Clear modulation bit0 before the shared single-byte stream advance.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; ConsumeSoundByte: Advance the stream pointer by one, then immediately interpret the next command. This is a command-chain loop, not a frame wait.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; EnableSoundPitchSlide: Set channel flag bit1, store the packed slide operand and seed its low-three-bit countdown before consuming two bytes.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; ConsumeSoundOperand: Advance the stream pointer by two for an opcode plus operand, then continue interpreting. The nearby path clears bit1 before using the one-byte advance.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].

; EnableSoundPitchEnvelope: Set modulation bit2, read the packed envelope operand, seed its low-nibble countdown and load a word envelope pointer from the operand high nibble. Consume opcode and operand; initialized RAM store template and channel domain0..8 remain required.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; DisableSoundPitchEnvelope: Clear channel flag bit2 and return to command decoding after consuming one byte.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; JumpSoundStream: Read the two-byte destination directly into the channel stream pointer and resume decoding there.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; JumpSoundWhenCounterNonzero: Jump to the operand pointer when the branch counter is nonzero; otherwise skip the three-byte command.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; JumpSoundWhenCounterZero: Use the opposite branch-counter predicate before sharing the stream jump or three-byte skip.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; SetSoundRestartPoint: Consume this command, save the resulting stream position as the restart pointer, and continue. The following command handles a nested stream call.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].

; CallSoundSubstream: Save the post-command stream position in a channel return slot and shift the packed return metadata, then load the two-byte substream address. Only classified portions of the bounded stack logic are shown.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; RestartSoundStream: Restore the channel restart pointer and fetch its next command.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].

; ReturnSoundSubstream: If no return slot remains, deactivate the channel except its ownership bit and silence/update it. Otherwise restore and clear a saved pointer, unwind packed metadata and resume the interpreter.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; DeriveSoundScale: Convert the low-five-bit parameter by repeated doubling and reduction modulo $18. Pack the result into the channel timing/register byte while preserving its other fields.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; DecodeSoundNote: Decode duration first. $C0..$CF advances a rest; $D0 and above also marks release and may silence the corresponding hardware channel. Lower values enter pitch conversion.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; PrepareSoundPitch: Split the note byte into nibbles; apply the channel mode and optional signed transposition while skipping invalid semitone codes.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; LoadExplicitSoundPeriodLow: Copy an inline byte into the period-low image, consume two bytes and join the hardware period update.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].

; WriteSoundNotePeriod: Use a word period table indexed by the pitch nibble and shift by the octave nibble. Store the period, consume the note, update hardware and reload modulation counters. The high period image preserves the non-period bits.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; SilenceSoundChannel: Tail-call the channel silencing helper; the adjacent entry adds A to the 16-bit stream pointer.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; AdvanceSoundPointer: Add A to the stream low byte and carry into the high byte; preserve X as the channel index.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].

; DecodeSoundDuration: Use the event low bits to choose a packed duration mode. One path multiplies the five-bit scale by a small factor; other classified paths derive delay from packed timing fields. Return the original event in A.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].

; MarkUnderlyingSoundChannel: Channels with index bit2 own/override a lower channel selected by index&3. Mark that underlying record with bit5 and return carry set; ordinary channels return carry clear.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; ReleaseUnderlyingSoundChannel: For an overriding channel, clear bit5 in the underlying channel and return its index in X with carry set. Carry clear means no underlying channel.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].

; ApplySoundVolumeSweep: Combine the sweep shape and phase to index signed nibble adjustments. Apply the adjustment to the volume nibble only if the result remains below16, then write the channel output.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; ApplySoundPitchSlide: Decode a signed step from the packed slide byte and add it to the low period byte, carrying into the three-bit high period field. Preserve the other register-image bits.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; TickSoundPitchEnvelope: Advance an envelope countdown and obtain a packed envelope-table value. Only the classified prefix is available; the later effect/loop is deliberately unresolved.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; ReturnFromEnvelopeCountdown: Return after the native nonzero envelope countdown decrements its channel counter. This is the matched subroutine suffix of the supported countdown branch.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; TickSoundPitchEnvelope: Advance an envelope countdown and obtain a packed envelope-table value. Only the classified prefix is available; the later effect/loop is deliberately unresolved.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].

; AdvanceSoundEnvelopeState: Update packed envelope countdown and phase from the envelope shape table. Low and high nibbles select hold, reload or phase progression, then return or join pitch-slide arithmetic. Channel X is zero through eight; initialized RAM hardware-store template and live stack above $0194 remain required. Original musical envelope naming is uncertain.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].

; InitializeSoundHardwareChannel: Select hardware channel register zero through the RAM-resident store helper and initialize its control registers. The neighboring helpers share channel-register address calculation.

; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; WriteSoundControl: Write the channel control value through the RAM helper unless bit5 says this channel is overridden.

; WriteSoundLengthRegister: Select register3 and emit the high period image with trigger/length bits set.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [6, 7, 14, 15].
; WriteSoundPeriod: Write the low and high period register images through the RAM helper, unless the channel is overridden.

Input, collision flags and surface type jointly select the subsequent handlers. Physical bank8 contains only this entry prefix; bank9 continues the same CPU execution window.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; TickPlayerSurfaceAnimation: Use an eleven-frame pose and a short countdown while travelling through the narrow vertical transition band; the two direction paths share health-decrement handling.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; FindPlayerTransportActor: For surface type5, scan four actor records at stride12 for type$85. Compare world position and step toward the selected record at a frame-divided rate.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].

; FinishPlayerTransportStep: Tick the transport contact countdown, normalize the player height into the supported band, then prioritize recovery, jump/fall and attack state before normal facing updates.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; CheckPlayerContactDamage: Gate health loss by recovery, surface and damage state. On damage set recovery timers, choose the normal or special-surface pose, request sound11 and return.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; CheckPlayerActionPress: Select press from the newly pressed input byte begins the action path. The other button path starts an attack only when the surface/state gate allows it.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; StartPlayerAttack: Set the attack and player-state high bits, seed its timer, request sound$18 and choose the attack pose from the inventory/mode flag.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].

; StartPlayerJump: A newly pressed A-like bit captures direction, clears the ascent accumulator and seeds a32-tick jump countdown. Probe the forward collision state and mark the obstruction flags before returning.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; MergePlayerJumpDirection: Copy the two direction bits into the collision/jump flag byte. Without directional input, refresh the player surface state.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].

; ProbePlayerVerticalInput: Probe the input-selected vertical direction, then test dynamic actor contact and the progress-sensitive interaction before moving or preparing a room transition. The second-slot path continues across the physical bank boundary.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].

; ProbeSecondActorForPlayerUpMove: Check the second dynamic slot for a supported blocking type and overlap. A special interaction may change progress; otherwise compare ground heights, adjust player height and choose movement or room transition.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; ProbePlayerDownInput: Check the down input bit and call the directional collision wrapper before the shared movement finish.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; FinishPlayerVerticalInput: Join the ordinary movement/surface handler; the separate downward-contact continuation checks the second actor and lower room boundary.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].

; ProbeSecondActorForPlayerDownMove: Check both dynamic slots through this second-slot continuation, compare ground heights and adjust player height toward the lower boundary. Enter room transition below the supported height band.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].

; TransitionPlayerRoom: When player and follower share a room, prepare large interaction extents and temporarily substitute the follower height before collision testing. Other rooms enter the room-transition lookup.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].

; RestoreFollowerTransitionExtents: Restore follower Y and half-extents after the transition overlap probe while preserving carry. On clear, save the exit selector and enter the player room-exit search.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].

; ResetFollowerAfterRoomExit: After the room-exit scan, pass the follower exit selector to the follower-specific wrapper, select pose $10, clear follower interaction state and choose ground/current height $8E or $62. Task selector is four; a no-match scan provides an ordinary bank-preserving return, without a universal exit-return claim.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; RequestPlayerRoomTransition: Pass the saved direction/exit selector to the fixed-bank room transition helper.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; ClearFollowerInteractionAfterExit: Clear follower interaction state and return after the second exit scan. The local no-match room-scan contract returns normally under task selector four.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; GatePlayerHorizontalMove: Certain surface types2/3 return without ordinary horizontal movement; all other supported types reach the input-driven step.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].

; MovePlayerFromInput: Install horizontal collision extents, choose direction from input bits0/1, and probe tiles. Actor contacts at offsets$18/$24 can block the step; accepted motion uses the shared world-coordinate step routine.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].

; ProbePlayerActorContacts: Scan both dynamic actor slots for supported high-bit types, compare overlap/direction and run the type9B progress interaction when eligible. The resulting progress flag chooses whether movement remains blocked.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; ComparePlayerContactDirection: When an actor was found, compare world-coordinate page and low byte, then compare that ordering with the requested step direction.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; CommitPlayerStep: Apply one horizontal unit, refresh surface state, and choose the animation. Surface6 can also use the current horizontal input to force a step.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; InitializePlayer: Activate the player, copy the stored spawn position, install collision extents and clear action/recovery state. Refresh the surface and join the animation handler.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].

; UpdatePlayerJump: Integrate vertical delta from jump countdown/ascent, derive facing-sensitive horizontal drift and test support. Search a bounded set of landing heights; on success save ground height, clear jump state and seed recovery/pose timers.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; ResetPlayerPoseState: Select player pose eight and clear the two player movement-state bytes. This complete mechanical initializer does not establish its original natural entry.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].

; UpdatePlayerFall: Request a sound at the initial32-tick state, integrate height during descent and use saved ground height for landing tests. Direction flags decide whether to apply one horizontal unit.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; StepPlayerDuringFall: Convert facing bit6 to the shared direction convention and move one unit.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; ProbePlayerAhead: Save world X, offset it by32 in the facing direction, perform directional and actor probes, set obstruction bit7 when blocked, then restore the exact original world position.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; UpdatePlayerAttackPose: Tick the attack countdown, choose timed poses depending on the mode flag, then clear the attack state and restore the neutral pose.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
; UpdatePlayerFacing: Convert the two horizontal input bits into facing bit6 and the associated state byte; avoid rewriting a direction already selected.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].

; StepActorWorldX: A low bit chooses increment/decrement; Y is the number of units and X the12-byte actor offset. Carry/borrow propagates between low world X and its page. The player path also requests camera movement near screen thresholds$50/$B0.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].

; RefreshPlayerSurface: Find a supporting object, normalize its type to seven bits, choose a pose for special surface types and update contact state. With no support, clear the surface type and restore neutral pose only outside action states.
; Effective physical PRG8KiB banks: [8, 9, 14, 15].
